name: medqa_s9_v1_r2_strict_late
responses: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.
My main symptom is Uterine tenderness. I also have Decreased bowel sounds, Increased frequency of urination, Fever.

Past medical history: Uncomplicated pregnancy leading up to a vaginal delivery. No significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: Does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use illicit drugs. Lives with her partner.

Complains of minor difficulty in breathing but denies any urinary pain, headache, vomiting, or diarrhea. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
